profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cummins
profile.summary:
Mr Eric Hensley is a managing consultant in the Cognitive Business Decision Support service line within IBM’s Global Business Services. Mr Hensley graduated from the College of William and Mary with a Bachelor of Arts in Economics and a minor in Applied Mathematics, a Master of Accounting, and a Master of Science in Business Analytics, becoming the first student athlete to finish their career with three degrees. In addition to technical and business skills, he also developed work ethic and personal accountability in advancing from a walk on to a full scholarship football player.

Eric began his career at IBM focusing on his core competency as a machine learning data scientist to provide value to clients through data modelling, prediction, and enrichment. Throughout these engagements, he has gained experience and established a track record of success while also expanding both the breadth and depth of his technical proficiency. His client deliverables now span various programming languages, operating systems, databases, and environments.

He leverages these aptitudes symbiotically to provide valuable data-driven solutions; full stack and lifecycle experience guides the navigation of client's environment while data science serves as the foundational first principle for design and implementation of solution architecture.

positions.title: Managing Consultant
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Owned delivery and guided maturity of resource augmentation and task automation tools which began as POCs
•	Managed day-to-day development of ~10 resources utilizing Agile approach
•	Interfaced with executives to provide demos, secure buy-in, and expand scope of utilization/adoption
Successfully delivered a SIT testing environment for the overall engagement within the client’s ecosystem.
•	Personally owned configuration updates and CI/CD deployment of existing engagement applications to the new environment.  
•	Produced new dev/test/deploy runbook for incorporating the new environment into existing process
•	Once delivered, owned coordination for onboarding client’s other siloed lines of business as well as the architectural resolution for their required integration patterns

Designed, developed, and deployed a big-data pipeline (> 100M rows) to enrich existing customer records with derived features to support personalized restaurant recommendations based on past transactions and Trip Advisor data. 
•	Owned the design of relational data model, process flow, and architecture. Also designed the set of derived/target features after meeting with the machine learning team to understand and synthesize their objectives.
•	Personally developed the solution using python, Hive, and pySpark. 
•	Deployed the solution within the client's ecosystem along with orchestration and triggers for automated weekly data refresh and final output migration to Couchbase.
•	Owned abstraction of the restaurant pipeline into a framework to allow for easy modular modifications which could support other use cases.
•	Marginal time/effort for adding new use cases cut by 75%. Client's data scientist successfully leveraged the framework to quickly create a pipeline for Attraction recommendations. 
•	Leveraged spaCy framework from a prior IBM engagement to develop a POC for automated redaction of JSON documents using an ensemble of custom spaCy models which evaluate both key and value.

positions.title: Lead Architect
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
•  Coordinated integration and owned back-end development in delivering a digital and workflow transformation for an international financial services firm
- Effectively communicated with client to design system architecture/data model and coordinate alignment of development with technical requirements
- Coordinated and aligned back-end solution to integrate with third-party front end application
- Personally designed, developed, and deployed Spring REST API to provide middle-ware support for UI functionalities as well as Kafka support for integrating the front-end solution to client's existing applications

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
•  Owned and managed the delivery and enterprise integration of parallel international work-streams in providing a $6M cognitive transformation to a flagship client's legacy system
1) Managed full stack development of a pipeline management/orchestration UI application
- Designed and negotiated client approval of architecture/data model
- Developed, deployed, and managed Oracle deployment of application data model
- Took initiative to personally develop and deploy supporting Flask REST API micro-service across multiple DevOps environments
- Organized, managed, and delegated front-end development to a team of 6 Angular UI developers based in India.  Coordinated development both remotely and on-site, working out of Bangalore for three months
- Successfully worked with the client through testing to address and remedy identified issues in a timely manner
2) Lead the back-end integration of project's cognitive digitization functionalities to the client's existing systems/ecosystem
- Coordinated technical development to remain aligned with and satisfying the changing requirements of the client
- Designed and developed Java modules which facilitated the system integration across several Kafka services

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description:
•  Designed, developed and deployed a company ranking tool to identify the high performing outliers among a bank's millions of prospects.
- Enriched internal company data with structured and unstructured data scraped from multiple external sources (FDIC, Yahoo Finance, SEC, US Census.. ect)
- Integrated data into a cloud deployed postgresql database.
- Developed unique approach for establishing ground truth of existing customers utilizing pareto criteria.
- Developed multi-step, multi-level ensemble approach for ranking prospects
• Designed, developed and deployed a full-stack sample Watson Natural Language Classifier application for demonstration to potential clients.
- Application can be found at https://erichensley-nlc-demo.mybluemix.net/
- Application featured in an article at Medium.com (https://medium.com/ibm-watson/e- commerce-product-categorization-with-watson-cf2130d7c94a).
- Video tutorial featured on IBM's Youtube (https://www.youtube.com/watch? v=JPMZxgpc_Uo).
- Project code can be found on Github (https://github.com/erichensleyibm/NLC_product_classifier-demo).
• Designed and developed an automated pipeline using python which integrates Webhose.io data retrieval, MongoDB data storage and Watson NLU data processing.  Deployed this solution to a VM and managed its processes and application for two different clients.  Worked with these clients to tune and validate the queries used as well as determine the insights with the most relevant use for their business needs.
• Developed Visual Basics multi-function program to automate a formerly manual internal task which was both labor and time intensive.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
• Connected with client through utilization of personal network and coordinated provision of independent consulting services
• Provided analytical support with development of statistical job and labor reports to identify efficiency opportunities
• Developed and implemented python based systems for automated parsing accounting software and updating of cost reports

positions.title: Risk Assurance Intern
positions.description:
•Provided value by testing ITGC’s, automated controls, and manual controls of companies such as Brinks, Altria, and Dominion
•Displayed professional skepticism and curiosity in investigating discrepancies and identified major IT control deficiency
•Sought out and participated in Data Assurance shadow experience gaining exposure to cleaning, formatting, and analyzing large amounts of raw data
•Developed teamwork, time management, and ability to learn quickly through working in very small teams to accomplish audits

positions.title: Campaign Assistant
positions.description:
Facilitated, organized, and operated campaign events and performing the necessary duties in a critical and nationally
covered electoral win by Rep. Comstock
* Coordinated 16 professional and voluntary workers to maximize logistical efficiency in canvassing neighborhoods and
distributing signs and bumper stickers for supporters
* Developed and displayed communication skills in meeting and explaining relevant campaign issues to potential voters
* Provided social media outreach to increase Rep. Barbara Comstock’s name recognition

projects.title: E-Commerce Product Categorization with Watson
projects.description:
Developed a full-stack interactive application to demonstrate the abilities of Watson Natural Language Classifier to potential E-commerce clients as well as provide an open source template and tutorial for others to use the tool.

The application was featured in an article in Medium: https://medium.com/ibm-watson/e-commerce-product-categorization-with-watson-cf2130d7c94a and the code can be found on GitHub: https://github.com/erichensleyibm/NLC_product_classifier-demo
